narr: A deep and persistent southwest flow over Alabama produced several waves of convection across north Alabama. Deeper moisture along the southern flank of the upper low also resulted in periods of heavy rainfall.
ev: Several clusters of thunderstorms with heavy rainfall produced flash flooding across northern Shelby County. Several roads were impassable along the Jefferson/Shelby county line with rain amounts estimated near 2 inches in one hour.
